# ui::TextInputEvent

Header: `winui/core/Input.hpp`.

Typed text, delivered to the focused element and bubbled up its parents like a key ([Element::handle_text()](../tree/element.md#handle_text)). It arrives separately from the [KeyEvent](key-event.md) of the key that typed it.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | The typed text, UTF-8: usually one character. |
